classifications.ci.yml: Scanner package command and isolated test database credential
classifications.tests: Synthetic fixtures and test hash values
classifications.audit_reports: SHA-256 of published source files, scanner output, pinned public rule commit and image/archive metadata; each new source digest checked
classifications.test_admin_catalog.py: Synthetic u:fixture@example.org URI to test rejection; no real provider credential
classifications.E2E: Three Playwright package integrity hashes checked against npm registry, synthetic local QA password, and a descriptive report filename; no real provider credentials

history: No pre-existing commits; final initial commit is restricted to reviewed tracked files. No provider validation, revocation or rotation performed.
prevention: CI rejects new file/type/hash candidates; output contains only file and line, never credential values
limitations: Pattern matching and entropy are not proof of absence; no provider credentials revoked or rotated
